note: Polarity axis: sort the 1,010 attributes by their net DIRECTIONAL value for existential philanthropy (batteries/polarity_axis.txt). One pairwise-ratio cardinal sort; the solved score IS a continuous signed orientation — top = good high-pole, bottom = bad high-pole (score should be flipped when composing), middle = orthogonal. Answers her 'attributes that have a pole very plausibly net-positive' selection with a graded axis rather than a brittle +1/-1/0 label. budget 12000 over 1010 entities ~= 24/entity. Composes with the AHP importance weights: grant score under goal G = sum over a of importance_G(a) * orient(a) * proposal_attribute_score(a), where orient(a) centers this polarity score.
